item.title: Trump and Pakistan say Iran deal could be signed Sunday but Tehran signals more time is needed

item.title: Mexican police investigate body found outside Tijuana stadium where Iran prepares for World Cup
item.description: Mexican authorities are investigating how a corpse ended up outside a stadium in the border city of Tijuana, where Iran’s national team has been training for its upcoming World Cup match against New Zealand

item.title: US strike against Tren de Aragua leader in Venezuela exemplifies Trump's approach to war on drugs
item.description: The Trump administration killed Venezuelan gang leader El Niño Guerrero during an airstrike conducted by the U.S. military in southeastern Venezuela
